name: the-crawler
title: TheCrawler — validated web extraction contracts for AI agents
description: Crawl pages, diagnose whether a source is ready for contract extraction, and extract typed JSON with validation evidence. Built-in real-estate-listing contract checks required fields, reports blockers before spending LLM tokens, and can write a buyer-readable diagnostic report. Also supports plain crawl output, markdown, heading-aware chunks, JSON-LD, microdata, commerce data, forms, analytics tracker detection, hreflang, redirects, structured errors, retryability, adaptive Cheerio-to-Playwright crawling, PDF, and DOCX. Open source engine (AGPL-3.0).
